quotes.text: The Continental Drifters emerged from the fertile L.A. pop scene of the 1980s and '90s, an ad hoc band of musicians mostly moonlighting from their "day bands," to collaborate in a free-form environment at Raji's nightclub in Hollywood.

Viewed by some as an L.A. counterpart to the freewheeling early-'70s Southern rock collective Delaney & Bonnie & Friends, the Continental Drifters combined sharp songwriting with skillfully executed instrumental interplay.
